subject: Online ordering portal unavailable - affecting customer orders at Vashi store
description: I have been unable to access the ServeWell online ordering portal since approximately 6:15 PM today (26 Feb 2026). When I attempt to log in using my staff credentials (employee ID: PA-0021-847), I receive an error message: 'Session Authentication Failed - User credentials could not be verified.' The portal was working normally during my morning shift. I have cleared browser cache, tried three different browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari), disabled ad blockers, and attempted login from both my personal laptop and the store's back-office computer without success. I also tried resetting my password through the 'Forgot Password' link, but that functionality appears to be returning a timeout error. This is impacting my ability to view my scheduled shifts for the upcoming week and verify my hours worked against payroll records. I noticed my February salary was deposited yesterday but appears to be significantly lower than expected - approximately 8,000 rupees short. I need to cross-reference my logged hours in the system to understand the discrepancy, but cannot proceed without portal access. Store operations are not directly affected as the customer-facing online order system remains functional, but I cannot perform my administrative duties regarding staff scheduling and time-tracking verification. I have a payroll inquiry meeting scheduled with store management tomorrow morning and need this resolved urgently.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and initially categorized under Online Orders - Portal Down. Agent performed basic connectivity checks on POS-0021-T1; system shows normal network status. Advised submitter to verify portal URL and check for recent browser updates.

Follow-up call placed to submitter. During conversation, submitter mentioned salary discrepancy and shift-hour verification concerns. Agent noted that issue may be HR/Payroll-related rather than technical portal outage. Ticket flagged for escalation to determine correct assignment.
